title: Team and player forms use React Hook Form with zodResolver
decision: Team and player forms move to React Hook Form with `zodResolver`, reusing `FormProvider`, `FormField` and `FormMessage` as the game forms already do. The default `onSubmit` mode keeps the current validation timing.
context: Team and player forms used raw `useState` with manually caught and stored Zod errors, unlike the game forms.

alternatives.option: Keep raw `useState` with manual Zod handling
alternatives.reason: No migration, but error handling grows with every field and stays inconsistent with the game forms.

consequences: Existing team and player forms must be migrated.
